# o11y_slo (Resource)

A revisioned O11y.one service-level objective with an exact rolling or timezone-aware calendar error-budget window.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "o11y_slo" "checkout" {
  slo_key         = "checkout-availability"
  name            = "Checkout availability"
  description     = "Monthly availability budget for checkout"
  sli_id          = "019f7aa2-6c7f-7000-8000-000000000001"
  sli_revision_id = "019f7aa2-6c7f-7000-8000-000000000002"
  target_ratio    = 0.999

  window_mode       = "calendar"
  calendar_period   = "month"
  calendar_timezone = "America/New_York"

  labels_json = jsonencode({ service = "checkout" })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `sli_id` (String) Durable SLI resource UUID.
- `sli_revision_id` (String) Immutable SLI revision UUID evaluated by this objective.
- `slo_key` (String) Stable objective key.
- `target_ratio` (Number) Target as a ratio strictly between 0 and 1.

### Optional

- `calendar_period` (String) day, week, month, or quarter. Required only in calendar mode.
- `calendar_timezone` (String) IANA timezone used for calendar reset boundaries. Required only in calendar mode.
- `description` (String)
- `labels_json` (String)
- `owner_display_name` (String)
- `owner_team_id` (String) Optional owner team UUID. Mutually exclusive with owner_user_id.
- `owner_user_id` (String) Optional owner user UUID. Mutually exclusive with owner_team_id.
- `rolling_window_seconds` (Number) Whole-minute rolling window. Defaults to 30 days in rolling mode and is zero in calendar mode.
- `window_mode` (String) rolling or calendar.

### Read-Only

- `archived` (Boolean)
- `config_hash` (String)
- `created_at` (String)
- `current_revision_id` (String)
- `effective_from` (String) Minute-aligned boundary from which the current revision owns the error budget.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `maximum_window_seconds` (Number) Maximum fact-retention horizon required by this window contract.
- `revision_number` (Number)
- `updated_at` (String)
